newsitem.title: MEXICO: Carso Telecom seeks more share capital.
newsitem.headline: Carso Telecom seeks more share capital.

text.p: Holding company Global Carso Telecom will seek shareholders' approval at its first assembly on October 1 to raise shareholding capital to finance acquisitions, a company spokesman said.
"We shall hold an assembly on October 1...and request an increase in shareholding capital," the spokesman added.
Global Carso Telecom was incorporated in July when Grupo Carso hived off its holdings in Telefonos de Mexico and other telecommunications companies.

Although the spokesman did not give details of which companies Carso Telecom might seek to acquire, in Mexico or elsewhere, he did say the company would continue to incorporate companies that generated synergies with Telefonos de Mexico.
"All the companies Telecom is acquiring have synergies with Telmex, in transmitting signals and data by cable," he added.
